quests.instruction: While waiting at the bus stop, where should you stand?
quests.correctAnswer: Back from the edge of the road 🚏
options: Back from the edge of the road 🚏
Right on the edge, ready to step on 🛣️
Just off the curb so you can see the bus 🚗
quests.explanation: Standing back keeps you away from passing vehicles.
quests.funFact: Buses stop at marked places so that everyone knows where to wait.

quests.instruction: Your bus has seat belts. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Wear yours for the whole trip 🪑
options: Wear it only when the driver reminds you 🎢
Take it off when the bus is nearly empty 🚶
Wear yours for the whole trip 🪑
quests.hint: Seat belts are there to keep you safe.
quests.explanation: Seat belts protect you if the bus brakes suddenly.
quests.funFact: Seat belts are among the most effective safety tools in vehicles.

quests.instruction: Where should your bag be on the school bus?
quests.correctAnswer: On your lap or under your seat 🎒
options: On your lap or under your seat 🎒
Near the door so you can leave fast 🚪
In the aisle where it is easy to reach 🚶
quests.explanation: Bags in the aisle can trip people, so keep them close to you.
quests.funFact: A clear aisle also lets everyone exit quickly in an emergency.

quests.instruction: An experiment is about to begin. What comes first?
quests.correctAnswer: Listen to the instructions first 👂
options: Skip the safety rules 🚫
Start mixing as soon as you can 🧪
Listen to the instructions first 👂
quests.explanation: Hearing every step prevents mistakes and accidents.
quests.funFact: Reading the instructions twice is a good habit.

quests.instruction: Why should you tie back long hair during science activities?
quests.correctAnswer: So it can't fall into the materials 🎀
options: So it can't fall into the materials 🎀
So that you look neat in photos 💇
So it stays dry and clean all day 💧
quests.hint: Think about what hair can touch.
quests.explanation: Loose hair can fall into materials or equipment, so tying it back is safer.
quests.funFact: Safety rules in labs are the same in many countries.

quests.instruction: May you taste materials during a science activity?
quests.correctAnswer: No, unless your teacher says it's food 🚫
options: Yes, if it looks and smells harmless 😋
No, unless your teacher says it's food 🚫
Yes, as long as it is only a tiny taste 👅
quests.hint: Some things look safe but aren't.
quests.explanation: Never taste, smell closely, or touch unknown materials unless told it's safe.
quests.funFact: Many substances look like food but aren't safe.

quests.instruction: Why should your shoelaces be tied firmly before PE?
quests.correctAnswer: So you don't trip while running 👟
options: So your feet stay cool when you run 🧊
So you don't trip while running 👟
So your shoes look neat and tidy 🎀
quests.explanation: Tied laces keep your shoes on and stop you tripping.
quests.funFact: Double knots stay tied better.

quests.instruction: You feel dizzy while running in PE. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Stop and tell your teacher 🛑
options: Run faster to feel better 🏃
Hide it from everyone 🤫
Stop and tell your teacher 🛑
quests.explanation: Stopping and telling an adult keeps you safe.
quests.funFact: Feeling dizzy can be a sign you need rest, water, or help.

quests.instruction: A PE teacher sets up equipment. When can you use it?
quests.correctAnswer: After the teacher gives instructions ✅
options: Before the teacher has arrived 🏃
Whenever you feel like using it 🤷
After the teacher gives instructions ✅
quests.explanation: Waiting for instructions means you know how to use equipment safely.
quests.funFact: Using equipment the wrong way is a common cause of injuries.

quests.instruction: Why should you wash your hands after using clay or paint?
quests.correctAnswer: To remove materials and germs 🧼
options: Because the water is warm 💧
To make the paint dry 🎨
To remove materials and germs 🧼
quests.explanation: Washing removes paint and clay from your skin before you touch your face or food.
quests.funFact: Some art materials aren't safe to eat.

quests.instruction: What should you do if glue gets near your eyes?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell your teacher and rinse with water 🚰
options: Rub your eyes to clear the glue away 👀
Tell your teacher and rinse with water 🚰
Wait and see if it stops stinging 🤞
quests.explanation: Rinsing with water and telling an adult is the safest step.
quests.funFact: Rubbing makes eyes more irritated.

quests.instruction: A bag of tiny beads is near a very young child. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Move them away and tell a teacher 🙋
options: Leave the bag where it is for now 🎒
Give a few beads to the child to hold 🤲
Move them away and tell a teacher 🙋
quests.explanation: Small beads can choke young children, so keep them out of reach.
quests.funFact: Toys for babies have to be larger than a certain size to be safe.

quests.instruction: Why should you not throw food at lunch?
quests.correctAnswer: It wastes food and makes floors slippery 🍽️
options: It wastes food and makes floors slippery 🍽️
It makes the hall too quiet for others 🤫
It gets your hands dirty and sticky 🧤
quests.explanation: Food on the floor is a slip hazard, and throwing it wastes what others might need.
quests.funFact: Food that is wasted also wastes the water and energy used to grow it.

quests.instruction: Why should you stay seated while eating?
quests.correctAnswer: It's safer and helps prevent choking 🪑
options: It keeps the floor from being walked on 👣
It's safer and helps prevent choking 🪑
It means you finish your lunch faster 🏃
quests.explanation: Sitting while you eat helps you chew properly and keeps food from going down the wrong way.
quests.funFact: Chewing food well helps your body digest it.

quests.instruction: You drop your fork on the floor at lunch. What is the best thing to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a lunch helper for a clean one 🍴
options: Ask a lunch helper for a clean one 🍴
Wipe it on your sleeve 👕
Pick it up and keep eating with it 🥄
quests.hint: A clean tool keeps germs out of your mouth.
quests.explanation: Floors carry germs, so a clean fork is the hygienic choice.
quests.funFact: Many germs are too small to see without a microscope.

quests.instruction: Why do schools have rules?
quests.correctAnswer: To keep everyone safe and let everyone learn 🛡️
options: To keep everyone safe and let everyone learn 🛡️
To give teachers more work to do 📋
To make school more difficult for students 📏
quests.explanation: Rules help students be safe and fair so that everyone can learn.
quests.funFact: Many rules were created because of a problem someone had earlier.

quests.instruction: A school rule says phones stay in bags during lessons. What is the reason?
quests.correctAnswer: It helps everyone focus on learning 📱
options: It helps everyone focus on learning 📱
Phones are too heavy for desks ⚖️
Phones tire out the students' eyes 🔋
quests.explanation: Putting phones away helps students pay attention to the lesson.
quests.funFact: Notifications can pull your attention away from what you're doing.

quests.instruction: A student forgets a rule. What usually happens next?
quests.correctAnswer: A teacher reminds them and helps 🧑‍🏫
options: Nothing is ever said about it to them 🤐
A teacher reminds them and helps 🧑‍🏫
They are sent home for the rest of the year 🏠
quests.explanation: Most of the time, adults remind students and help them do better next time.
quests.funFact: Learning from mistakes is part of growing up.

quests.instruction: Your teacher reminds you to walk in the hallway. What is the best response?
quests.correctAnswer: Say 'okay' and start walking 🚶
options: Walk, but only when the teacher is looking 👀
Say 'okay' and start walking 🚶
Say 'okay' and keep running a little 🏃
quests.explanation: Listening to reminders keeps you and others safe.
quests.funFact: School rules and traffic rules both exist so many people can share a space safely.

quests.instruction: You think a school rule is unfair. What is a good way to share your view?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask politely to talk about it with a teacher later 🗣️
options: Break the rule once to show why it is unfair 🚫
Complain about it loudly in front of the class 📢
Ask politely to talk about it with a teacher later 🗣️
quests.explanation: Speaking calmly at the right time gives your idea a chance to be heard.
quests.funFact: Students' ideas have changed rules in many schools.

quests.instruction: You see a classmate break a small rule. What is a sensible choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Remind them kindly or tell a teacher 🙋
options: Copy what they did so they are not alone 👥
Remind them kindly or tell a teacher 🙋
Laugh at them so they feel embarrassed 💬
quests.explanation: A kind reminder helps, and unsafe actions should be reported to an adult.
quests.funFact: Telling a teacher about danger is different from tattling.

quests.instruction: A person you don't know asks for your home address near the school gate. What do you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Walk away and tell a trusted adult 🚶
options: Give the address so they can be polite 🗣️
Write down the address and hand it over ✍️
Walk away and tell a trusted adult 🚶
quests.explanation: Strangers don't need your address, so leave and tell an adult.
quests.funFact: Your family can tell you which adults you can trust.

quests.instruction: A friend asks you to keep a secret that makes you feel unsafe. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a trusted adult 🙋
options: Tell everyone else 📢
Tell a trusted adult 🙋
Keep it secret 🤐
quests.hint: Some secrets are not okay to keep.
quests.explanation: If a secret makes you feel scared or unsafe, tell an adult you trust.
quests.funFact: Adults at school are there to help you.

quests.instruction: You get separated from your class on a field trip. What is the best thing to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Stay put and ask a staff member for help 🙋
options: Ask a stranger to walk you to the exit 🚪
Stay put and ask a staff member for help 🙋
Wander off to look for the group yourself 🚶
quests.hint: Staying put makes it easier to be found.
quests.explanation: Staying in one place lets your teachers find you quickly.
quests.funFact: Teachers count students often on trips.

quests.instruction: You see a classmate fall and hurt their leg badly. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Get the nearest adult right away 🏃
options: Wait for someone else to notice and help 🚶
Try to carry your classmate to the nurse 🏋️
Get the nearest adult right away 🏃
quests.hint: Quick help from adults is best.
quests.explanation: Telling an adult quickly gets the right help to your classmate.
quests.funFact: Don't move someone who is badly hurt unless an adult says so.

quests.instruction: You smell smoke in the hallway and no adult is near. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Move away and tell an adult right away 🏃
options: Move away and tell an adult right away 🏃
Keep playing until you hear the alarm 🎮
Go closer to see where it is coming from 👀
quests.explanation: Moving away and alerting an adult is safest, and the adult can call for help.
quests.funFact: If you smell smoke, tell someone straight away, even if you're not sure.

quests.instruction: Why is it good to know your home address and a parent's phone number?
quests.correctAnswer: So adults can contact your family if needed ☎️
options: So adults can contact your family if needed ☎️
So you can write them on your desk later ✏️
So you can share them with new friends 💬
quests.explanation: Knowing these details helps school staff reach your family quickly.
quests.funFact: Practice saying them aloud so you remember.

quests.instruction: A classmate is running with open scissors in the classroom. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a teacher right away 🙋
options: Chase them and grab the scissors 🏃
Ignore it 🙈
Tell a teacher right away 🙋
quests.hint: Think about the adult in charge.
quests.explanation: Running with open scissors could hurt someone, so telling an adult is the safest way.
quests.funFact: A calm voice is more effective than shouting.

quests.instruction: The fire alarm sounds while you are painting. Your painting is unfinished. What do you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Leave it and line up with your class 🚶
options: Leave it and line up with your class 🚶
Finish one more corner of the picture 🖌️
Take the painting with you on the way 🖼️
quests.explanation: Leaving immediately is safest, because a painting can be done later.
quests.funFact: Most people can escape a fire safely when they leave quickly and do not stop for belongings.

quests.instruction: A younger child's shoelace is undone at the top of the stairs. What is a good thing to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask them to tie it before going down 🙋
options: Hurry them downstairs before the bell rings 🏃
Ask them to tie it before going down 🙋
Walk past, since it is their own shoelace 🚶
quests.hint: Tripping on stairs can be dangerous.
quests.explanation: Fixing the lace before they go down prevents a fall.
quests.funFact: Helping others stay safe is a way of caring for your school.
